title: Existence and Uniqueness of Block Decomposition
body_html:
Existence and Uniqueness of Block Decomposition

Every supercuspidal datum \(\Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho)\) decomposes as an orthogonal direct sum \[ \Sigma=\bigoplus_{l=0}^{b}\Sigma_l \] where \(\Sigma_0\) is a depth-zero block and each \(\Sigma_l\) for \(l>0\) is a single positive-depth block. The positive depths are distinct and strictly ordered. The decomposition is unique up to the equivalence relation on supercuspidal data used in the paper.

deps.title: Block Decomposition of a Supercuspidal Datum
